sylvie: Postmortem follow-up for PM-2026-44 (intermittent capacity collapse). I'm putting a compact action list here with proposed owners and minimal acceptance criteria so we can close the loop. Please ack or request a handoff within 48h.

Actions (short):
- JIRA-12001: add per-model backpressure + short throttle (owner: omar) - acceptance: feature-flagged, dashboard with p95/p99 by model, quickstop PR merged
- JIRA-12002: rollout canary + automated rollback (owner: ben, consult: eng-deploy) - acceptance: canary harness + rollback subtask, health evaluator defined
- JIRA-12003: runbook update + tabletop (owner: claire) - acceptance: runbook PR, tabletop scheduled, verification checklist
- JIRA-12004: KV eviction recurrence fingerprinting (owner: omar) - acceptance: time-series + heap samples attached, reproduction attempt logged
- internal: add recurrence flag + weekly review card (owner: sylvie) - acceptance: automation on board + recurrence checklist

omar: I can take 12001 and 12004. For 12001 I'll ship a quick throttle behind a flag (hotfix/12001-quick) and add a p99-by-model panel. For 12004 I'll attach eviction traces; initial analysis EOD Wed.

ben: I'll take 12002. Proposed RACI: Ben (R), eng-deploy (C), Sylvie (A). I'll open JIRA-12002.1 for the canary harness and include rollback criteria: fail if p99 > baseline*1.4 for 10m or error-rate > 0.5%. Canary default 20m.

claire: I'll own 12003. I'll draft the runbook change and add a short tabletop script that includes a verification step requiring a "remediation-verification" comment (format below) before PM close. PR later today.

ops-bot: Created subtask JIRA-12002.1: https://jira.redwood.local/browse/JIRA-12002.1

sylvie: Process asks: (1) split cross-team remediations into subtasks per team with clear RACI, (2) require exactly-formatted verification comment before PM closure. Verification format: `remediation-verification: SHA=<sha> smoke=<id> traces=<link> notes=<short>`

omar: Agree on subtasks. For 12001 quickstop I'll add tests and ping @ben for integration hooks. If we need to swap owners, post here within 48h.

ben: Opening subtask now and tagging eng-deploy. Will include canary health evaluator and rollback automation steps.

claire: PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops-runbooks/pull/1300 - adds tabletop script + verification checklist. Includes sample verification comment for PM owners.

sylvie: I'll wire the recurrence automation to the board and add a weekly 30m slot. Closing owner assignment in 48h unless someone asks to swap. Thanks! :white_check_mark:

omar: Acked. I'll update JIRA-12001 and 12004 with RACI and ETAs.

ben: Ack. Subtask created and ETA added.

claire: Acked. Tabletop scheduled and PR open.

sylvie: Closing assignment window 48h. If any remediation grows beyond quickstop, please split into quickstop + full-remediation subtasks.
